dish.title: Tex-Mex Skirt Steak Fajitas with Peppers, Onions, and Pico de Gallo
dish.description: Skirt steak marinated in lime juice, garlic, cumin, and chili powder, seared hard in cast iron and sliced across the grain, served with charred bell peppers and onion, warm flour tortillas, fresh pico de gallo of tomato, onion, jalapeno, and cilantro, avocado, and sour cream.

recipe_version.immutability_note: v2 supersedes v1. Doneness instruction only. kitchen_tested is false. Not a household rating.
recipe_version.title: Tex-Mex Skirt Steak Fajitas with Peppers, Onions, and Pico de Gallo
recipe_version.description: Skirt steak marinated in lime juice, garlic, cumin, and chili powder, seared hard in cast iron and sliced across the grain, served with charred bell peppers and onion, warm flour tortillas, fresh pico de gallo of tomato, onion, jalapeno, and cilantro, avocado, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: chili powder
ingredients.display_name: chili powder whose label lists chile, cumin, oregano, garlic, and salt

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/4 tsp steak, 1/2 tsp peppers, 1/4 tsp pico

ingredients.name: bell peppers
ingredients.display_name: mixed red, yellow, and green bell peppers

ingredients.name: white onion
ingredients.note: 1 sliced for the skillet, 1/4 diced for pico

ingredients.name: flour tortillas
ingredients.display_name: 8-inch flour tortillas whose label lists wheat flour, water, vegetable shortening, baking powder, and salt (no lard)

steps.title: Prep and marinate
steps.body: Toss the steak in the medium bowl with 1/4 cup lime juice, the garlic, cumin, chili powder, 1 tbsp oil, and 1 1/4 tsp salt, and let it sit 15 minutes while you work. Slice the peppers and 1 onion. Dice the tomatoes and 1/4 onion, mince the jalapeno, and chop the cilantro; stir them in the small bowl with the remaining lime juice and 1/4 tsp salt for pico. Slice the avocado.

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.body: Heat the cast-iron skillet over high until smoking, about 4 minutes. Add 1 tbsp oil and sear 2 pieces of steak (pat off excess marinade) until deeply browned and 145 F, about 4 minutes per side. Repeat (2 batches). Rest on the cutting board 5 minutes. Optional traditional preparation: medium-rare, about 130 F. That lower temperature does not meet the USDA/FDA recommendation and carries higher risk, especially for young children, pregnant people, older adults, and anyone immunocompromised.

steps.title: Char the peppers
steps.body: While the steak rests (overlap stated): add 1 tbsp oil, the peppers, sliced onion, and 1/2 tsp salt to the skillet and cook, tossing, until charred at the edges and crisp-tender, about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.body: Warm each tortilla in the skillet over medium, about 20 seconds per side, and wrap in the kitchen towel.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.body: Slice the steak thinly across the grain and pile it with the peppers and onions. Serve with tortillas, pico, avocado, and sour cream.

coverage_contribution: Steak in the catalog is chimichurri, au poivre, gochujang flank, lomo saltado, and cheesesteaks; there is no fajita night. A build-your-own beef dinner.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with peruvian-lomo-saltado: lime-cumin skirt steak with peppers in flour tortillas, not a soy-vinegar stir-fry with fries and rice. Compared with philly-cheesesteaks: sliced seared steak with pico and avocado in tortillas, not chopped steak and cheese in rolls. Compared with gochujang-grilled-flank-steak: a Tex-Mex lime and chili marinade, not a Korean chile paste glaze.
not_duplicate_of: Not carne asada tacos (flour tortillas, peppers and onions) and not a steak burrito.
